items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; not expected to play per Rapoport. Davante Adams expected to carry primary load.
items.why: Hip injury; McVay notes limited progress, possible return next week vs Eagles.
items.implication: Adams becomes clear WR1 with elevated routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua historically; recent 8-195-2.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday.
items.why: Injury; positive longer-term per Rapoport, not IR.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; McLaurin target share historically solid with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Houston passing game.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz saw 28-30% target share/routes last week without Collins.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.opportunity: Coach: Warren will lead group, freshened with breathers; expect checkdown volume from Rodgers.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in for Sunday; hope early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.implication: Start as normal pending final; big DFS implications.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Committee back; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Both active limits any single back ceiling.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RB group; projecting him in despite Q (shoulder). Expect heavy checkdowns as vertical game failed for Rodgers.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle absence; backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume + pass-game upside.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (5 games total career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Heavy carries vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most yds to TEs.
items.why: Collins OUT boost + matchup; 30% routes targeted prior.

items.text: Davante Adams: 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%; prior miss games 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.why: Historical without Nacua + current D status.
items.implication: WR1 upside if Nacua out again.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th %ile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceilings live; updates for news.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 util 86; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep efficiency vs soft secondary.
